posts.name: Aditya
posts.cooked:
HI @TalhaButt2508,

Thanks.
Pls find the below client script:

frappe.ui.form.on(‘Sales Invoice’, {
customer: function(frm) {

    frm.fields_dict['recipients'].get_query = null;
    if (frm.doc.customer) {
        
        frappe.call({
            method: 'frappe.client.get_list',
            args: {
                doctype: 'Contact',
                filters: {
                    customer: frm.doc.customer  // Filter by the selected customer
                },
                fields: ['email_id']  // We only need the email_id field
            },
            callback: function(response) {
                
                const emails = response.message.map(contact => contact.email_id).filter(Boolean);
                if (emails.length > 0) {
                   
                    frm.fields_dict['recipients'].get_query = function(doc) {
                        return {
                            filters: [['email_id', 'in', emails]]
                        };
                    };
                    frm.refresh_field('recipients');
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

});

Regards,
ADitya
